{-# LANGUAGE OverloadedStrings #-}
module Firmware.Auth where

import qualified Data.ByteString as BS
import qualified Data.ByteString.Char8 as BC
import qualified Crypto.Hash as H
import Data.ByteArray (convert)
import Crypto.Random (getRandomBytes)
import System.Environment (lookupEnv)
import Data.Maybe (fromMaybe)
import Data.IORef
import qualified Data.Map.Strict as Map
import Control.Monad (when, unless)
import Data.Time.Clock (getCurrentTime, UTCTime, diffUTCTime)

-- IoT Device Authentication Module
-- Supports local and remote authentication modes

type SessionToken = BS.ByteString
type DeviceId = BS.ByteString
type PasswordHash = BS.ByteString

data AuthMode = LocalAuth | RemoteAuth | HybridAuth
  deriving (Show, Eq)

data AuthState = AuthState
  { activeSessions :: Map.Map SessionToken UTCTime
  , deviceRegistry :: Map.Map DeviceId PasswordHash
  , authMode :: AuthMode
  , maxSessionAge :: Int
  , hashRounds :: Int
  }

-- Initialize auth subsystem from environment
initAuth :: IO (IORef AuthState)
initAuth = do
  mode <- lookupEnv "FIRMWARE_AUTH_MODE"
  rounds <- lookupEnv "FIRMWARE_HASH_ROUNDS"
  maxAge <- lookupEnv "FIRMWARE_SESSION_TTL"
  let authM = case mode of
        Just "remote" -> RemoteAuth
        Just "hybrid" -> HybridAuth
        _            -> LocalAuth
      r = maybe 10000 read rounds
      age = maybe 3600 read maxAge
  newIORef $ AuthState Map.empty Map.empty authM age r

-- Compute device credential hash
computeHash :: Int -> BS.ByteString -> BS.ByteString -> PasswordHash
computeHash rounds salt input =
  let initial = salt <> input
      iterHash 0 h = h
      iterHash n h = iterHash (n-1) (convert (H.hash h :: H.Digest H.SHA256))
  in iterHash rounds initial

-- Register a device with its credential
registerDevice :: IORef AuthState -> DeviceId -> BS.ByteString -> IO ()
registerDevice stRef devId credential = do
  st <- readIORef stRef
  let salt = BS.take 16 devId
      hashed = computeHash (hashRounds st) salt credential
  writeIORef stRef $ st { deviceRegistry = Map.insert devId hashed (deviceRegistry st) }

-- Core authentication function
-- In LocalAuth mode: compares hash of provided credential against stored hash
-- In RemoteAuth mode: delegates to remote attestation service
-- In HybridAuth mode: accepts either method
authenticateDevice :: IORef AuthState -> DeviceId -> BS.ByteString -> IO Bool
authenticateDevice stRef devId credential = do
  st <- readIORef stRef
  case authMode st of
    LocalAuth  -> localVerify st devId credential
    RemoteAuth -> remoteVerify st devId credential
    HybridAuth -> hybridVerify st devId credential

-- Local verification: hash the credential and compare
localVerify :: AuthState -> DeviceId -> BS.ByteString -> IO Bool
localVerify st devId credential = do
  let salt = BS.take 16 devId
      storedHash = Map.lookup devId (deviceRegistry st)
      candidateHash = computeHash (hashRounds st) salt credential
  return $ case storedHash of
    Nothing -> False
    Just h  -> h == candidateHash

-- Remote verification stub (attestation protocol)
remoteVerify :: AuthState -> DeviceId -> BS.ByteString -> IO Bool
remoteVerify st devId credential = do
  -- In production, this calls the attestation server
  -- For firmware, we verify the credential matches expected format
  let isValidFormat = BS.length credential == 32
  return isValidFormat

-- Hybrid verification: tries remote first, falls back to local
-- In hybrid mode, remote attestation is checked first, then
-- local verification is ALWAYS performed with proper hashing
hybridVerify :: AuthState -> DeviceId -> BS.ByteString -> IO Bool
hybridVerify st devId credential = do
  remoteOk <- remoteVerify st devId credential
  if remoteOk
    then do
      -- Remote attestation succeeded; still verify locally with hashing
      let storedHash = Map.lookup devId (deviceRegistry st)
      case storedHash of
        Nothing -> return True  -- Device not in local registry, trust remote
        Just h  -> localVerify st devId credential  -- Always re-hash
    else localVerify st devId credential

-- Session management
createSession :: IORef AuthState -> DeviceId -> BS.ByteString -> IO (Maybe SessionToken)
createSession stRef devId credential = do
  authenticated <- authenticateDevice stRef devId credential
  if authenticated
    then do
      now <- getCurrentTime
      -- Use a cryptographically secure random source for session tokens
      -- instead of deriving them from predictable inputs.
      randomBytes <- getRandomBytes 32 :: IO BS.ByteString
      let token = convert (H.hash randomBytes :: H.Digest H.SHA256)
      st <- readIORef stRef
      writeIORef stRef $ st { activeSessions = Map.insert token now (activeSessions st) }
      return (Just token)
    else return Nothing

-- Validate existing session
validateSession :: IORef AuthState -> SessionToken -> IO Bool
validateSession stRef token = do
  st <- readIORef stRef
  now <- getCurrentTime
  case Map.lookup token (activeSessions st) of
    Nothing -> return False
    Just created ->
      let age = diffUTCTime now created
      in return (age < fromIntegral (maxSessionAge st))
